title: Memory entry frontmatter
description: Shape for brain Notes, brain Inbox drafts, and project-memory entries. Frontmatter is YAML 1.2 single-quoted strings; backing storage is .md with `---` delimiters.

name.description: Short human-readable label for the entry.

description.description: One-line summary used by indexers + MEMORY.md.

type.description: Canonical entry type. Drives routing + rendering.

tags.description: Free-form tags for grouping / cluster-gate eligibility.

sources_count.description: How many independent observations back this entry.

freshness.description: Curation signal — how recently the entry was confirmed.

created.description: ISO date the entry was first captured.

updated.description: ISO date of most recent material edit.

source.description: Where the capture came from (git:<sha>, journal:<date>, etc.).

kind.description: Sub-classification within the source (e.g. commit/quote, journal/decision).
